in_marathi.name: Bhagjit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhagjit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhagjit is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'bhag', meaning 'fortune' or 'blessing'. In Hindu mythology, Bhagjit is considered to be an auspicious and fortunate name. It is believed to bestow blessings and good luck upon the bearer.
